zh: 开完会我打给你。
en: I'll give you a ring after the meeting.
alt: I'll call you once the meeting's finished.
point: “开完会”说 after the meeting 就行，不用 finish the meeting

zh: 等你有空再说吧。
en: Let's talk about it when you're free.
alt: We can chat when you've got a minute.
point: “等…再…”用 when 从句，不说 wait you free

zh: 要是卡住了就重启一下。
en: If it freezes, just restart it.
alt: Just reboot it if it hangs.
point: 中文“就”不翻；if 从句用现在时，主句用祈使句

zh: 保存了再关。
en: Save it before you close it.
alt: Make sure you save it before closing it.
point: “…了再…”表示先后，用 before，不是 then again

zh: 等菜上齐了再吃吧。
en: Let's wait until all the food comes out.
alt: Let's wait till everything's here before we start.
point: “等…再”用 wait until，until 后用现在时

zh: 吃完了叫服务员买单。
en: When we're done, let's ask for the bill.
alt: Let's get the bill once we've finished.
point: “吃完了”用 when we're done；买单是 the bill，不是 buy the menu

zh: 下雨的话比赛就取消。
en: If it rains, the game's off.
alt: The match will be cancelled if it rains.
point: “下雨的话”是 if it rains，不说 if it will rain

zh: 一听到哨声就开始跑。
en: Start running as soon as you hear the whistle.
point: “一…就…”用 as soon as，不是 one hear then run

zh: 你路过超市帮我买点牛奶。
en: If you're passing Countdown, can you grab some milk?
alt: Can you get milk when you go past the shops?
point: “路过”用 if you're passing / when you go past

zh: 不合适可以退。
en: You can return it if it doesn't fit.
alt: If it doesn't fit, you can bring it back.
point: 中文省掉“如果”，英文一定要补上 if

zh: 到了给我发个信息。
en: Text me when you get there.
alt: Flick me a message once you arrive.
point: “到了”指将来，用 when you get there，不用 arrived

zh: 过安检之前把水喝完。
en: Finish your water before you go through security.
point: “之前”在英文里放后面：before + 从句；过安检 go through security

zh: 不舒服就请假。
en: If you're not feeling well, take the day off.
alt: Take a sick day if you're feeling crook.
point: “不舒服”是 not feeling well；“就”不翻，用 if

zh: 饭后吃这个药。
en: Take this after you eat.
alt: Take these after meals.
point: “饭后”是 after you eat / after meals，不说 after rice

zh: 出门前关灯。
en: Turn the lights off before you leave.
alt: Switch the lights off before you head out.
point: “出门”是 leave / head out，不是 go out the door

zh: 我到家就给你回电话。
en: I'll call you back as soon as I get home.
point: “就”用 as soon as，从句用现在时 get，不说 will get

zh: 你来了我们就开始。
en: We'll start once you're here.
alt: We'll kick off as soon as you arrive.
point: “你来了”是将来，用 once you're here，不用 came

zh: 周末不忙就过来吃烧烤吧。
en: Come over for a BBQ this weekend if you're not busy.
alt: If you're free this weekend, come round for a barbie.
point: “不忙就…”用 if you're not busy，放句尾很自然

zh: 钱到账了告诉我。
en: Let me know when the money comes through.
alt: Tell me once the money's gone in.
point: “到账”是 come through / go in，不说 arrive account

zh: 不够的话我借你。
en: If you're short, I can lend you some.
point: “不够”是 if you're short；借给你用 lend，不是 borrow

zh: 等 Aroha 休假回来，我们再定这件事。
en: We'll make a call on that when Aroha's back from leave.
alt: Let's decide once Aroha gets back from leave.
point: when 后用现在时 's back，不说 will be back；“定”是 make a call

zh: 这份报告你看完以后转给财务部。
en: Once you've been through the report, forward it on to Finance.
alt: After you've read the report, can you send it to Finance?
point: “看完以后”用 once + 现在完成时 you've been through

zh: 部署前先备份一下数据库，以防万一。
en: Back up the database before we deploy, just in case.
alt: Let's take a backup of the database before deploying, just in case.
point: “以防万一”是 just in case，放在句尾

zh: 直到我清了缓存，页面才正常显示。
en: The page didn't load properly until I cleared the cache.
alt: It wasn't until I cleared the cache that the page loaded properly.
point: “直到…才…”要用 didn't … until，主句用否定

zh: 你要是不吃辣，可以叫他们少放点辣椒。
en: If you can't handle spicy food, ask them to go easy on the chilli.
point: “不吃辣”是 can't handle spicy；“少放”是 go easy on

zh: 我们一坐下，服务员就把水端上来了。
en: As soon as we sat down, the waiter brought us some water.
alt: The moment we sat down, the waiter brought over some water.
point: 过去的“一…就…”也用 as soon as，两边都用过去时

zh: 我一般等孩子睡了才去跑步。
en: I usually wait until the kids are asleep before I go for a run.
alt: I don't usually go for my run until the kids are in bed.
point: “等…了才…”是 wait until … before，不说 wait kids sleep

zh: 全黑队今晚要是赢了，就进决赛了。
en: If the All Blacks win tonight, they'll be in the final.
alt: The All Blacks will make the final if they win tonight.
point: if 从句用现在时 win，will 只放在主句

zh: 这个降价了你通知我一声好吗？
en: Can you let me know if it goes on sale?
alt: Could you tell me when it's on special?
point: “降价”是 go on sale / on special；if 后用现在时

zh: 等黑五再买吧，到时候肯定更便宜。
en: I'd wait until Black Friday — it'll definitely be cheaper then.
alt: Wait till Black Friday to buy it — it's bound to be cheaper.
point: “等…再买”是 wait until，“到时候”是 then

zh: 我们得在天黑前赶到陶波。
en: We need to get to Taupō before it gets dark.
alt: We've got to make it to Taupō before dark.
point: “天黑前”是 before it gets dark，dark 前要有 it gets

zh: 万一航班延误了，我们就在机场附近住一晚。
en: If the flight's delayed, we'll just stay the night near the airport.
point: “万一…就…”这里用 if，if 后不用 will

zh: 我包里总带着创可贴，以防孩子摔倒。
en: I always keep plasters in my bag in case the kids fall over.
alt: I always carry plasters in case the kids hurt themselves.
point: “以防”是 in case，后面用现在时；创可贴叫 plaster

zh: 打完疫苗以后在这儿坐十五分钟再走。
en: After your jab, please wait here for fifteen minutes before you leave.
alt: Please stay for fifteen minutes after your vaccination before heading off.
point: “打完疫苗以后”是 after your jab；“再走”用 before you leave

zh: 我做饭的时候你能帮我看一下孩子吗？
en: Can you keep an eye on the kids while I'm cooking?
alt: Could you watch the kids while I make dinner?
point: 正在做的“…的时候”用 while + 进行时；看孩子 keep an eye on

zh: 房东说下周修理工来了再修热水器。
en: The landlord says the hot water cylinder will get fixed when the plumber comes next week.
point: 说的是下周，when 后仍用现在时 comes

zh: 你到奥克兰的话一定要告诉我，我请你喝咖啡。
en: If you're ever in Auckland, let me know and I'll shout you a coffee.
point: “到…的话”是 if you're ever in；“我请你”Kiwi 说 shout

zh: 聚会完了你要是没车，我开车送你回去。
en: I can drop you home after the party if you need a lift.
alt: If you need a ride after the party, I'll take you home.
point: “送你回去”是 drop you home / give you a lift

zh: 工资一到账我就把房租转给你。
en: I'll transfer the rent as soon as I get paid.
alt: I'll send you the rent money once my pay comes in.
point: “工资到账”直接说 get paid；as soon as 后用现在时

zh: 除非利率降下来，不然我们暂时不买房。
en: We're not buying a house unless interest rates come down.
alt: We won't buy a place unless the rates drop.
point: “除非…不然”只要 unless，不要再加 otherwise

zh: 等我们拿到客户的反馈之后，再决定要不要推进第二阶段。
en: Once we've heard back from the client, we can decide whether to go ahead with phase two.
alt: We'll make a decision on phase two once we've got the client's feedback in hand.
point: “拿到反馈”是 hear back from；“要不要”用 whether to

zh: 你要是周五前搞不定，提前跟我说一声，我好找人帮你。
en: If you can't get it done by Friday, give me a heads-up so I can find someone to help.
point: “提前说一声”是 give me a heads-up；“周五前完成”用 by Friday

zh: 补丁上线之前我们先别动生产环境，免得把事情搞得更糟。
en: Let's leave production alone until the patch goes out, so we don't end up making things worse.
alt: We shouldn't touch production before the patch is released, or we might make things worse.
point: “之前先别”用 not … until / leave … alone until

zh: 万一迁移出问题，我们得有个回滚方案，所以周末之前一定要测好。
en: We need a rollback plan in case the migration goes wrong, so it has to be tested before the weekend.
point: 预防性的“万一”用 in case，后面用现在时 goes wrong

zh: 如果周六晚上要订十个人的位子，最好提前一周打电话，不然肯定订不到。
en: If you want a table for ten on a Saturday night, you'd better ring a week ahead or they'll be fully booked.
point: “最好”是 you'd better；“不然”用 or，不说 if not

zh: 等主菜上来的时候我们估计已经饱了，所以前菜少点一点。
en: By the time the mains come out, we'll probably be full, so let's not order too many starters.
point: “等…的时候已经…”用 by the time，从句现在时，主句将来

zh: 只要大家每周坚持来训练两次，等赛季开始的时候我们肯定没问题。
en: As long as everyone keeps turning up to training twice a week, we'll be fine by the time the season starts.
point: “只要”是 as long as，不是 only need；从句用现在时

zh: 膝盖完全好之前教练不让我上场，估计还得再坐一个月板凳。
en: The coach won't let me play until my knee's fully recovered, which probably means another month on the sidelines.
point: “…之前不让”用 won't … until；坐板凳是 on the sidelines

zh: 网上下单满一百块包邮，而且下午两点前下单的当天就能发货。
en: If you order online, shipping's free over a hundred bucks, and anything ordered before 2 pm goes out the same day.
point: “满…包邮”是 free shipping over…；“发货”说 goes out

zh: 这台冰箱你先别急着买，等年中大促再看看，能省不少钱。
en: I'd hold off on that fridge until the mid-year sales — you could save a fair bit.
alt: Don't rush into buying that fridge; wait for the mid-year sales and you'll save heaps.
point: “先别急着买”是 hold off on；“等…再”用 until

zh: 你们到了皇后镇以后先去取车，等我们晚上到了再一起吃饭。
en: Once you land in Queenstown, go and pick up the rental car, and we'll all have dinner together when we get in tonight.
point: 两个“到了”都是将来，用 once / when + 现在时

zh: 出发之前记得查一下路况，要是沙漠公路因为下雪封了，我们就绕道走。
en: Check the road conditions before we leave — if the Desert Road's closed because of snow, we'll take the long way round.
point: “封路”是 closed；“绕道”是 take the long way round

zh: 等你复查结果出来以后，我们再讨论要不要做手术。
en: Once your follow-up results come back, we'll talk about whether surgery's the right option.
point: “结果出来”是 results come back；“要不要”用 whether

zh: 症状要是比较轻的话，先打健康热线问一下，不一定非得去急诊。
en: If your symptoms are fairly mild, try ringing Healthline first — you don't necessarily need to go to ED.
alt: If it's only mild, call Healthline first; you might not need to go to A&E.
point: “不一定非得”是 don't necessarily need to

zh: 我们搬进去之前，房东答应找人把地毯洗了，还会把漏水的水龙头修好。
en: Before we move in, the landlord's agreed to get the carpets cleaned and sort out the leaky tap.
point: before 后用现在时；“找人洗”用 get + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 我不在家的这几天，你能不能帮我浇浇花，顺便看看有没有快递？
en: While I'm away, could you water the plants and check if any parcels turn up?
point: “不在家的这几天”是 while I'm away；“有没有”用 check if

zh: 那天晚上你要是实在过不来也没关系，等你下次回奥克兰我们再聚。
en: No worries if you can't make it that night — we'll catch up next time you're back in Auckland.
point: “过不来”是 can't make it；next time 本身就是连词，不再加 when

zh: 我们刚到他家没多久就下起了大雨，只好把东西全搬进车库。
en: We'd only just got to their place when it started bucketing down, so we had to move everything into the garage.
point: “刚…就…”用 had only just … when；下大雨 bucketing down

zh: 签合同之前，最好先找个会计帮你看一下，免得以后在税上吃亏。
en: Before you sign anything, get an accountant to look it over, otherwise you might get caught out on tax later.
point: “免得…吃亏”用 otherwise … get caught out

zh: 银行一批贷款，我们就跟卖家把交房日期定下来。
en: Once the bank approves the loan, we'll lock in the settlement date with the seller.
alt: As soon as the loan's approved, we'll confirm the settlement date with the vendor.
point: “一…就…”用 once / as soon as；新西兰买房交割叫 settlement
